actions.action: Convert the Phase 5 generated context-relevance proposal into bounded directive LD-2026-08-25-066 after explicit operator ALLOW.

Add a canonical candidate-retrieval result contract and a shared authority-neutral receipt-item projection for learnings, next improvements, failures, friction, residual risks, evidence references, and decision references.
Implement deterministic lexical candidate retrieval with hard candidate limits, future cutoff, same-project boundary, and one-hop expansion through governed context relations.

Modify the Context Compiler so retrieval is only an additional relevance basis and all existing freshness, supersession, invalidation, contradiction, provenance, and context-budget controls remain authoritative.
Wire explicit task retrieval through the runner before context compilation and expose separate candidate_retrieval and compiled_context records while leaving execution_authorized false.

Add positive and adversarial regression tests proving improved recall beyond exact scope and continued compiler rejection of future, stale, superseded, contradicted, zero-overlap, and over-budget candidates.
Run the generalized Leverage Engine regression suite, DiffWall, and repository-map validation, then merge PR #67 under explicit operator authorization.

changes.change_summary: Added deterministic bounded candidate retrieval before context admission.
Added retrieval as an explicit relevance basis without weakening existing compiler gates.
Centralized authority-neutral receipt item projection for retrieval and compilation.
Wired candidate retrieval before Context Compiler and retained separation from execution authority.

validation.scope: candidate retrieval contract, retrieval-first fixture, adversarial retrieval/compiler boundaries, and all prior Leverage Engine regression behavior
Operator Intelligence registry and generated repository-map integrity

operator_interventions.reason: Explicitly authorized generated proposal LE-IMPROVE-dbfc7509df5b19c7 and restated the required Retriever proposes / Compiler admits architecture.
operator_interventions.effect: Phase 6 implementation and merge were authorized within the bounded candidate-retrieval scope; no subsequent source-adapter expansion was authorized.

review_events.rationale: Explicit Phase 6 authorization combined with passing Leverage Engine regression, DiffWall ALLOW, and repository-map validation permitted the bounded merge.

friction: The current repository exposes evidence and decision standards/templates but does not expose a single canonical machine-readable evidence-object and decision-object store suitable for direct retriever ingestion.
v0.1 retrieval is deliberately lexical and same-project; this proves the control architecture but does not yet provide semantic or cross-project recall.

reusable_learnings.learning: Candidate recall can be widened safely when retrieval produces only item IDs and provenance while the deterministic Context Compiler remains the sole admission boundary for agent context.

Evidence references and decision references can be retrieved as authority-neutral historical context, but a reference string must not be treated as equivalent to a canonical evidence or decision object.

reused_experience.statement: Improve context candidate recall without weakening deterministic admission controls.
reused_experience.application: Phase 6 added bounded deterministic candidate retrieval before the existing Context Compiler and represented retrieval as relevance evidence rather than admission authority.
reused_experience.observed_effect: A test run with intentionally unrelated exact scope can retrieve a relevant prior item, while stale, future, superseded, contradicted, and over-budget retrieved items remain rejected by the compiler and execution_authorized remains false.

residual_risks: Candidate retrieval is lexical rather than semantic; relevant concepts expressed with disjoint vocabulary will not be proposed.
Retrieval is currently bounded to retained receipts in the same project; direct adapters for canonical evidence, decision, source-registry, or cross-project graph stores are not implemented.
Evidence and decision candidates currently contain retained references rather than fetched canonical object content.
One-hop graph expansion uses the existing context relation registry, which currently models supersession, contradiction, and invalidation rather than a broad operational knowledge graph.
Graph Engineering OS browser UI still does not render retrieval results or compiled context directly.
gate_reasons: retriever proposes and Context Compiler remains the sole admission boundary
full Leverage Engine regression suite passes

next_improvement.objective: Define bounded source-adapter contracts for canonical evidence and decision objects before expanding candidate retrieval beyond receipt-local references.
next_improvement.rationale: Phase 6 safely retrieves receipt-local evidence and decision references, but repository inspection found standards/templates rather than a single canonical machine-readable evidence/decision object store. Direct source expansion should therefore begin with an explicit adapter and object contract instead of treating references or markdown templates as authoritative objects.
